source_caption:
Who's Your Caddy? follows Christopher “C-Note” Hawkins, a wealthy rapper who wants to join an exclusive country club after buying property nearby. However, the club’s members try to stop him because they dislike his flashy lifestyle and background. C-Note responds by challenging their traditions and bringing his own energetic style into the club.

In Who's Your Caddy?, the clash between old-fashioned country club culture and modern hip-hop lifestyle creates many comedic situations and misunderstandings. The film mixes satire, sports comedy, and over-the-top humor while focusing on themes of class differences, acceptance, and confidence. Known for its celebrity appearances and lighthearted tone, it became a popular comedy among fans of early 2000s humor.

source_details.title: Who's Your Caddy?
source_details.synopsis: Who's Your Caddy? is a 2007 American comedy film directed by Don Michael Paul and starring Big Boi, Lil Wayne, Andy Milonakis, Faizon Love, Terry Crews, Tony Cox, Jeffrey Jones and Jesper Parnevik. It is the first film produced by Robert L. Johnson's Our Stories Films studio. The film was released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer and The Weinstein Company on July 27, 2007. It received negative reviews and grossed $5.7 million against a $7 million budget.
